Messages.Author: brettscho
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Well, you've got some gems in that list. Unfortunately, as Ankha implied, the price kind of depends on your location because a fair number of sets are still available in Europe, but not the US. Also, it's hard to judge prices at the moment because interest in buying cards seems to be slumping slightly (which will naturally drive prices down).

Lords of the Night and Sword of Caine are cheaply available in Europe, but somewhat difficult to find in the US, but that is only a recent phenomena, so I'd estimate $50-$75 (maybe as high as $100) for a box.

Legacies of Blood and Keepers of Tradition haven't been available for a good long time. The difference is that few players are interested in Legacies of Blood, but everybody wants Keepers. I honestly haven't seen a box of KoT being sold in a long time so I have no idea what you'd get for it, but it's certainly the most expensive item on your list. LoB is maybe $100+.

Your Third Edition boosters are kind of in the middle ground between the cheap boxes (LotN and SoC) and the expensive ones (LoB and KoT). It's somewhat difficult to find, but players also aren't as interested because the card back is upside down, and many of the crypt cards are considered to be less good than the alternatives.

Finally, the Lords of the Night starters are pretty cheap (I'd be surprised if they're worth $10 a piece). Keepers of Tradition starters are cheap in Europe, but quite pricy in the US. Good luck selling your cards!

Brett
